name: Ever After
tagline: A wedding planner for Android: countdown, checklist, budget, guests and vendors in one place.
description:
Ever After is a wedding planner for Android. It brings the countdown to your wedding day, your checklist, budget, guest list and vendor list together in one place, styled like a letterpress stationery set.

Pick your wedding colours from eight schemes or choose your own, and use the app in light mode, dark mode or following your phone. Everything you enter is stored on your phone. There is no account to create.

Ever After is free with a small banner ad. A one-time "Remove ads" purchase turns the ads off.
features: Countdown to the wedding day
Wedding checklist with a starter list of tasks
Budget with expenses
Guest list and vendor list
Eight wedding colour schemes, or your own colour
Light and dark appearance
Available in 19 languages
Data stays on your phone, no account needed

name: Kvit og frit
tagline: A receipt and warranty keeper for Android: scan a receipt and get a reminder before the warranty or return window runs out.
description:
Kvit og frit keeps your receipts and warranties in one place, styled like a till slip. Scan a receipt and the app reads the shop, date, total and items on your phone, then reminds you before the warranty or the return window ends.

Bought a present? Send the receipt by text message or email, so they can exchange it themselves. At the shop counter, the receipt and its barcode are shown full screen, together with a short guide to your rights as a consumer in your country.

Everything is stored on your phone. There is no account to create.

Kvit og frit is under development and not yet on Google Play. Features may change before it is released.
features: Scan receipts; the shop, date, total and items are read on your phone
Reminders before a warranty or return period ends
Several items and categories on one receipt
Send a receipt to someone, or save one you received
The receipt and its barcode full screen at the counter
Consumer rights for your country
Backup to a file you choose, and moving to a new phone
Available in 19 languages, with any currency
Data stays on your phone, no account needed

name: Regnorm
tagline: A plant care app for Android that waters by the weather: it follows the rain, sun and frost where your garden is.
description:
Regnorm keeps track of your plants, outside and inside. For the garden it reads the weather from the Danish Meteorological Institute (DMI) and works out, plant by plant, when the soil is getting dry, so you don't water after a day of rain. Houseplants follow a watering schedule that slows down in winter.

A worm in a speech bubble tells you what needs doing, and warns you before a frost night. You can also track how tall your plants grow, note pot sizes and get a nudge when one has outgrown its pot, and see what to sow, plant and harvest each month.

Everything is stored on your phone. There is no account to create.

Regnorm is under development and not yet on Google Play. Features may change before it is released.
features: Watering by the weather for garden plants, from DMI's open data
Watering schedules for houseplants, gentler in winter
Frost warnings for plants that can't take it
Plant heights and pot sizes, with repotting suggestions
A garden calendar for sowing, planting and harvest
An optional morning reminder
Available in 19 languages
Data stays on your phone, no account needed
